description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Nextcloud's text-to-image AI provider (e.g. Stable Diffusion via LocalAI). Returns the task ID; use get_task_result to check completion.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

savePath.description: Optional Nextcloud path to save the generated image (e.g. '/Photos/generated.png'). If omitted, only the task ID is returned.

name: generate_image
title: Generate Image
